modules.title: 注册人数逐步减少时，最大流失发生在哪里
转化漏斗怎样提供可靠线索

items.title: 先定义步骤和成功结果
items.text: 每一步都对应可以采集的真实行为，顺序、允许间隔和最终目标需要与业务问题一致。

items.title: 统一用户与时间口径
items.text: 人数是否去重、用户能否从中间进入、观察多长时间都会改变结果，比较前必须保持一致。

items.title: 流失位置不等于流失原因
items.text: 漏斗告诉我们先调查哪里；页面问题、规则限制、技术错误或用户意愿仍需其他证据验证。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: {c:user-flow} 描述产品允许用户怎样完成目标；{c:conversion-funnel} 用行为数据统计实际有多少用户到达每一步。流程图可以帮助定义漏斗步骤，但不能代替真实数据。

lessonPractice.title: 注册漏斗显示：访问 1,000 人、开始注册 620 人、提交资料 310 人、完成注册 280 人。应先调查哪里？

options.label: 先调查“开始注册 → 提交资料”，同时核对两个事件的定义和采集是否一致
options.feedback: 对。这一步从 620 人降到 310 人，步骤转化率为 50%，是当前最大流失；先核对数据口径，再调查页面、规则和用户原因。

options.label: 只看最终有 280 人完成，不需要检查中间步骤
options.feedback: 最终人数不能说明主要阻碍发生在哪里，中间步骤正是漏斗提供的定位线索。

options.label: 直接认定资料表单太长并删除字段，不核对事件或用户反馈
options.feedback: 漏斗说明哪里流失，不会自动解释为什么。原因仍需数据检查和用户证据。

en.title: A sign-up funnel shows 1,000 visits, 620 starts, 310 profile submissions, and 280 completions. What should the team investigate first?

options.label: Investigate start → profile submission first, while verifying that both events use matching definitions and tracking
options.feedback: Correct. This step falls from 620 to 310, a 50% step conversion and the largest loss. Verify the data before investigating interface, rules, and user reasons.

options.label: Look only at the 280 completions and ignore intermediate steps
options.feedback: The final count cannot locate the main obstacle. Intermediate steps are the funnel's diagnostic value.

options.label: Assume the form is too long and delete fields without checking events or user feedback
options.feedback: A funnel shows where loss happens, not why. The cause still needs data checks and user evidence.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请用这份真实事件数据整理注册转化漏斗：访问、开始注册、提交资料、注册完成。先核对每个事件定义、去重方式、时间范围和用户口径，再计算每步人数、步骤转化率和流失。指出最大流失位置，但把原因写成待验证问题，不要补造用户数据，也不要直接删除页面内容。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Build a sign-up conversion funnel from this real event data: visit, start sign-up, submit profile, and complete sign-up. First verify each event definition, deduplication method, time window, and user scope. Then calculate counts, step conversion, and drop-off. Identify the largest loss, but keep possible causes as questions to validate. Do not invent user data or directly remove interface content.

learning.assumes: You can map task steps but do not yet know how behavior data locates the largest loss.
learning.outcome: You can verify funnel steps, user scope, time window, and event definitions, then read step conversion and distinguish a funnel from a user flow.

modules.title: Find the largest loss as sign-up counts narrow
How a conversion funnel provides reliable clues

items.title: Define steps and the success outcome
items.text: Each step needs a real trackable action and an order that matches the question.

items.title: Use one user and time definition
items.text: Deduplication, entry rules, and observation windows change the result and must remain consistent.

items.title: Location is not cause
items.text: A funnel shows where to investigate; interface, rule, technical, and motivation causes still need evidence.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: A {c:user-flow} describes the allowed path. A {c:conversion-funnel} counts how many people actually reach each step. A flow can define funnel steps but cannot replace data.
